## Installation

1. Download and install the [NFS Underground 2 Fusion Fix](https://fusionfix.io/wfp#nfsu2) - it includes the required [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader).
2. Download [Fusion Rain Droplets for NFSU2](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/FusionRainDroplets/releases/download/nfsu2/NFSUnderground2.FusionRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` file into the `scripts` folder.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

Used Xbox Rain Droplets before? Delete the old `NFSUnderground2.XboxRainDroplets.asi`: while it is there, the game shows a message and closes.

## Notes

- Change the settings on [fusionfix.io](https://fusionfix.io) or in FusionFixHub; changes apply while the game runs. They are stored in the `.cfg` next to the plugin.
